draft_en.subject: On the PoE extender you were looking for - a straight answer, and what we do carry
draft_en.body:
Hi Riccardo,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 17 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

Straight answer on the PoE extender and EoC you were looking for: we do not carry them, so I will not pretend otherwise. What we do carry, neutral-brand, at distributor price, EXW, MOQ 1, 15-day validity, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD; budget unmanaged 8 x PoE+ + 2 x Gigabit - STC-028GP - $25.1; 4 x PoE+ + 2 x Gigabit - STC-204GP - $24.2. You read Chinese - happy to continue in Chinese if easier.

One question: for the sites where you wanted the extender, how far is the camera from the switch - that decides whether an SFP-uplink switch at the far end solves it instead?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
